url.title: Url
url.description: Repository or folder to pull from. Empty leaves it unchanged.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Branch or tag to track. Empty leaves it unchanged.

ssh_key_path.title: Ssh Key Path
ssh_key_path.description: Private key for an SSH repository. Empty string clears it back to the admin user's key; omitted leaves it unchanged.

ca_bundle_path.title: Ca Bundle Path
ca_bundle_path.description: CA bundle for a self-hosted https repository. Empty string clears it back to the host's default trust store; omitted leaves it unchanged.
